name: Ms.Denvers
source:
Wanda Denvers is a 40-year-old single mother with a son and two daughters.

She's the principal of Middleton High School.

This story focuses on her life after 5 years of divorce, as she battles with the task of having to take care of 3 people on her own. It's now been so long since she had a love life she feels more lonely than ever before. How will she fill the pit of emptiness in her life? You decide.

[From [url=https://popdoggy.itch.io/msdenvers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
旺達．丹佛斯是一位40歲的單親媽媽，育有一子二女。

她是米德爾頓高中的校長。

本作聚焦於她離婚五年後的生活，講述她獨自一人艱難撫養三個孩子的故事。如今她已經太久沒有過感情生活，比以往任何時候都感到孤單。她將如何填補生活中的空虛？一切由你決定。
